newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Vendex sees EPS up on BIS buy.
newsitem.headline: Vendex sees EPS up on BIS buy.

text.p: Retail and business services group Vendex International NV said on Monday it expected a positive effect on its results from the takeover of France's temporary employment group BIS SA announced earlier today.
"The acquisition will have a slightly positive effect on Vendex International's profits per share in the financial year 1997/98," the Dutch company said in a statement.

Vendex reached agreement with BIS's founders' family to buy their 60 percent stake in BIS at a price of 490 francs per share. Vendex will make a public bid at the same price for the other shares which are listed on the Paris Stock Exchange.
In total the French group has 5.1 million shares outstanding, putting the acquisition price at about 2.5 billion francs or more than 800 million guilders.
Vendex said it will pay the takeover sum in cash and added it would finance the transaction from its existing credit lines.
